q: give me a net profit breakdown, waterfall for September 2026
answer:
Tilting Heads lost ₹172,227 in September 2026 on a P&L (event-date) basis — the business made a positive contribution margin of ₹1,021,095 but P&L ad spend of ₹1,193,322 pushed the month into a net loss of ₹172,227.

Key points
- Top line and deductions: Gross sales were ₹2,253,539 → after discounts (₹110,359), returns (₹371,999) and cancels (₹73,845) P&L net sales = ₹1,697,336. This shows returns and discounts together subtracted ~₹556k from gross sales.
- Cost of goods and operating costs: Net COGS = ₹676,241 (product cost ₹553,170 + operating cost ₹123,071). These are the second-largest drain after ad spend and leave contribution margin at ₹1,021,095.
- Advertising pushed the result negative: P&L ad spend = ₹1,193,322, larger than the contribution margin and the primary cause of the net loss.
- Final reconciliation (waterfall): Gross sales ₹2,253,539 − discounts ₹110,359 − returns ₹371,999 − cancels ₹73,845 − product cost ₹553,170 − shipping/packaging/gateway/RTO (combined ₹123,071) − ad spend ₹1,193,322 = Net profit −₹172,227 (all figures P&L / event-date).

Worth checking: ad spend efficiency (ROAS by channel/product) and the drivers of the ₹372k return revenue (which cut net sales materially).

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
